HEADLINE: UK Publisher Loses 98% Of News Search Visibility After .com Move via @sejournal, @MattGSouthern

blog.headline: When a Domain Shift Wipes Out 98% of Your Search Visibility
blog.angle: A UK publisher’s move from .co.uk to .com promised global scale but triggered a catastrophic loss in search visibility, revealing how domain migrations can silently dismantle digital equity and why founders must plan for SEO fallout before chasing growth.

linkedin.headline: One domain change, and a publisher’s audience disappeared overnight.
linkedin.angle: Domain migrations aimed at globalizing a brand can obliterate hard-earned search visibility, forcing founders to rethink digital expansion strategies.

facebook.headline: A UK news publisher lost almost all its search visibility after switching domains. Could your brand survive the same?
facebook.angle: When a .co.uk site moved to .com, it lost 98% of trending search traffic—what does that mean for your digital growth plans?

instagram.headline: Domain Change Destroyed 98% Visibility
instagram.angle: Scaling a brand by changing domains can erase your digital footprint overnight—visibility isn’t guaranteed.

threads.thread_hook: Switching your domain can kill your search traffic. Here’s what happened when a UK publisher moved from .co.uk to .com and lost 98% of its news search visibility.
threads.angle: This thread breaks down the hidden risks of domain migrations, why SEO doesn’t always follow the move, and what founders need to know before shifting their digital foundation.

stories.story_question: Thinking of switching your domain to scale? What if you lose 98% of your search traffic?
stories.angle: Exploring the tension between global ambitions and the fragile digital equity that can vanish with a domain change.

images.hook_text: One domain change, and a publisher’s audience disappeared overnight.
